result.summary: Found 4 issues including a loading spinner stuck on a restaurant card, cut-off content at screen edge, and minor layout inconsistencies.

issues.description: Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a loading spinner overlay on top of the food image, suggesting content failed to load or is stuck loading
issues.suggestion: Ensure the image loads properly and remove the spinner once content is ready; add a timeout/error state if loading fails

issues.description: Third restaurant card 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' row is cut off at the right edge of the screen
issues.suggestion: Adjust horizontal scroll/padding so cards are either fully visible or clearly indicate scrollability with a partial peek

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated without ellipsis styling or full name visible
issues.suggestion: Ensure text truncation uses proper ellipsis and consider showing full name on tap or in a tooltip

issues.description: Heart/favorite icon on Tokumaru Ramen Bar card is white while on the pizza card below it is black, creating inconsistent icon styling across similar cards
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon color/style across all restaurant cards regardless of background image
